        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def get_min_max_rect(grid, color):
    """Get bounding box of all cells of a given color"""
    positions = []
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            if grid[r][c] == color:
                positions.append((r, c))
    
    if not positions:
        return None
    
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in positions)
    max_r = max(p[0] for p in positions)
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in positions)
    max_c = max(p[1] for p in positions)
    
    return (min_r, max_r, min_c, max_c)

# Check each non-background color
for color in range(256):
    if color == background_color:
        continue
    
    positions = [(r, c) for r in range(height) for c in range(width) if test_input[r][c] == color]
    
    if not positions:

    # Get bounding box
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in positions)
    max_r = max(p[0] for p in positions)
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in positions)
    max_c = max(p[1] for p in positions)
    
    interior_h = max_r - min_r - 1

                    visited.add((cr,cc))
                    positions.append((cr,cc))
                    for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
                        nr, nc = cr+dr, cc+dc
                        if 0 <= nr < len(grid) and 0 <= nc < len(grid[0]):
